new_subsection.title: European Union: CHMP positive opinion (as of 22 October 2026)

entries.value: On 15 October 2026, the European Medicines Agency’s Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP) adopted a positive opinion recommending the granting of an EU marketing authorisation for Foundayo (orforglipron). The applicant is Eli Lilly Nederland B.V. A CHMP opinion is a recommendation, not an authorisation: Foundayo becomes authorised in the EU only if the European Commission issues a decision. EMA listed Foundayo as “pending EC decision” when checked on 22 October 2026.

The indication recommended by the CHMP covers two uses in adults. Weight management, “including weight loss and weight maintenance,” as an adjunct to healthy diet and physical activity, in adults with an initial BMI of ≥30 kg/m² (obesity), or ≥27 kg/m² to <30 kg/m² (overweight) with at least one weight-related comorbidity. Type 2 diabetes mellitus: treatment of adults with insufficiently controlled type 2 diabetes as an adjunct to healthy diet and physical activity, either as monotherapy when metformin is considered inappropriate or in combination with other medicinal products for the treatment of diabetes.

United States comparison: FDA approved Foundayo on 1 April 2026 (NDA 220934). The current U.S. labeling (Drugs@FDA and DailyMed, checked 22 October 2026) indicates it, in combination with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity, to reduce excess body weight and maintain weight reduction long term in adults with obesity, or adults with overweight and at least one weight-related comorbid condition. The U.S. label does not include a type 2 diabetes indication, so the indication recommended by the CHMP is broader than the current U.S. one.
Neither the CHMP opinion nor the U.S. approval applies to research-chemical material sold under the orforglipron name.
